biuro-ksiegowe.title: Modern Accounting Office
biuro-ksiegowe.description: A modern website for an accounting office, designed in a clean and professional style with a focus on trust, clarity of services, and generating client inquiries.
biuro-ksiegowe.overview: A website project for an accounting firm aimed at creating a professional, visually calm experience that helps clients easily understand the offer and quickly get in touch.
work: UX/UI design in a modern, minimalist style
Design of trust-building sections (reviews, stats, numbers)
Creation of a clear hero section with CTA
highlights: Clean and calm design that builds trust
Clear presentation of services and client benefits
Improved conversion through CTA and contact form
Modern look that stands out from competitors

challenges.problem: The website needed to be simple and understandable for clients without accounting knowledge.
challenges.solution: Use of plain language, clear sections, and supportive icons.

challenges.problem: Accounting websites often look outdated and unattractive.
challenges.solution: Implementation of a modern layout, light color palette, and clean UI.

challenges.problem: Encouraging users to take action and get in touch.
challenges.solution: Visible CTAs, contact section, and logical user flow across the page.

decisions: Next.js for performance and modern architecture
Tailwind CSS for fast and consistent UI development
Light and calm color palette (green + gray)
Conversion-focused sections (CTA, services, contact)
integrations: Scalable structure for future CMS integration

crescent-development.title: Crescent Development
crescent-development.description: A modern real estate website designed in a premium style, focused on showcasing properties and generating leads.
crescent-development.overview: A website project for a real estate developer aiming to create a modern, visually appealing and conversion-focused platform for presenting active investments.
highlights: Modern and elegant design tailored to real estate industry
Clear presentation of investments and offers
Improved user flow towards contact and conversion
Strong foundation for scaling and future development

challenges.problem: The website needed to feel premium but remain clean and easy to navigate.
challenges.solution: Minimal layout, strong typography and limited color palette.

challenges.problem: Presenting multiple investments in a clear way.
challenges.solution: Projects section with dynamic pages for each investment.

challenges.problem: The website needed to support sales, not just aesthetics.
challenges.solution: Multiple conversion points (CTA sections, contact form).

decisions: Next.js instead of WordPress for performance and flexibility
Tailwind CSS for consistent and fast UI development
Minimal premium design (gold + dark navy palette)
Conversion-driven layout (CTA, projects, contact)

spiro-pilates-mobility.title: Spiro Pilates & Mobility
spiro-pilates-mobility.description: A modern website for a pilates and mobility studio, designed to build a calm and professional brand image while making it easier for clients to get in touch.
spiro-pilates-mobility.overview: A website project for a wellness studio that needed an elegant, lightweight, and easy-to-manage online presence with room for future growth.
work: Editable content sections built with ACF
highlights: Light and elegant website tailored to the wellness industry
Simple editing panel for the owner
Strong foundation for future content growth and SEO

challenges.problem: The website had to be launched quickly due to a project deadline.
challenges.solution: The work was divided into stages, with the key sections delivered first.

challenges.problem: The site needed to be easy to manage without using page builders.
challenges.solution: I used a custom WordPress theme and ACF to simplify content editing.

challenges.problem: The offer and class schedule could change over time.
challenges.solution: I designed flexible sections and integrated the site with Fitssey.

decisions: Custom WordPress instead of a pre-made template
ACF instead of a page builder for better performance and control
Polylang for multilingual support
Minimalist design tailored to the wellness industry

lion-force-weld.title: Lion Force Weld
lion-force-weld.description: A company website designed to organize the offer, highlight the brand’s professionalism, and make client contact fast and easy.
lion-force-weld.overview: A project for a welding company that needed a clearer service presentation and a stronger online presence.
highlights: Clear presentation of services and contact details
More professional brand perception
Strong base for future website growth and SEO

challenges.problem: The client did not have a ready or structured content system.
challenges.solution: I designed a flexible section layout that can be easily expanded and updated.

challenges.problem: The editing panel had to stay simple and avoid page builders.
challenges.solution: I implemented ACF as the main content editing tool to keep the dashboard easy to use.

decisions: Custom WordPress theme instead of a ready-made template
ACF instead of page builders for better performance
Simple, technical design tailored to the industry

luisowka.title: Luisówka
luisowka.description: A modern mountain cabin website with a custom availability inquiry system, designed to combine aesthetics, easy booking flow, and simple management.
luisowka.overview: A website project for a rental property where both attractive presentation and practical reservation handling were essential.
work: Implementation with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Inquiry form, basic SEO, and legal pages
highlights: Consistent and visually appealing presentation of the rental offer
Custom admin panel for reservation management
Website prepared for SEO, performance, and future growth

challenges.problem: Overlapping reservations had to be prevented.
challenges.solution: I added date range validation and blocked booked dates in the calendar.

challenges.problem: A simple admin panel was needed without relying on WordPress.
challenges.solution: I built a custom CRUD admin panel in Next.js with Firestore security logic.

challenges.problem: The website had to clearly communicate privacy and form-related information.
challenges.solution: I prepared clear legal pages and a transparent inquiry flow.

decisions: Next.js for speed and simple deployment on Vercel
Custom calendar logic instead of heavy third-party solutions
Consistent styling system based on Tailwind CSS

zdrowie-plus.title: Zdrowie+
zdrowie-plus.description: A light and clear website for a wellness brand, designed to guide users through the offer, content, and contact flow in a simple and structured way.
zdrowie-plus.overview: A concept website for a wellness brand with a strong focus on aesthetics, content consistency, and clear calls to action.
highlights: Clear layout with easy user paths
Consistent brand communication
Structure ready for future blog and content expansion

challenges.problem: The design needed to stay visually light despite many sections.
challenges.solution: I used a modular grid, a limited color palette, and consistent typography.

challenges.problem: Animations had to add energy without hurting performance.
challenges.solution: I used subtle micro-animations instead of heavy visual effects.

decisions: Framer Motion used sparingly and only where it supports UX
Reusable card system for visual consistency
Semantic structure for better SEO

quest-for-paws.title: Quest for Paws
quest-for-paws.description: An empathetic and easy-to-use website for an animal support organization, designed to make adoption, support, and contact paths simple and accessible.
quest-for-paws.overview: A foundation website project where accessibility, clear navigation, and action-oriented user flow were the key priorities.
work: Adoption, support, and contact form design
Contrast, focus states, and aria improvements
highlights: Improved readability of forms and content
Shorter path to adoption and support
More accessible and better organized interface

challenges.problem: The website included a lot of emotional content and imagery, but still had to remain clear and readable.
challenges.solution: I used calm typography, balanced image proportions, and a clear section structure.

challenges.problem: The site needed to be more accessible for screen reader users.
challenges.solution: I refined the heading structure, ARIA roles, focus rings, and alternative text.

decisions: WCAG AA-compliant contrast
Consistent placement of key action buttons
Focus on simple and intuitive navigation

realestate.title: RealEstate
realestate.description: A minimalist landing page for the real estate industry, designed to build trust quickly and guide users toward contact.
realestate.overview: A website project focused on clear offer presentation, strong value points, and an effective contact form.
work: Lightweight property list with room for future expansion
highlights: Clear presentation of the offer and key value points
Trust-building sections
Structure ready for future CMS expansion

challenges.problem: A lot of property information had to fit into a limited space.
challenges.solution: I used repeatable cards with clear content hierarchy and a simple CTA.

decisions: Minimal animations with performance in mind
Flexible grid ready for future filters and expansion
Simple section layout focused on lead generation

marecki-24-7.title: Marecki 24/7
marecki-24-7.description: A roadside assistance and repair website designed so users in stressful situations can instantly see the key services and call without friction.
marecki-24-7.overview: A service website project where fast contact, mobile clarity, and straightforward offer presentation were the top priorities.
work: Service, location, and working hours sections
highlights: Instant access to the phone number
Clear layout on mobile devices
Better service presentation for urgent situations

challenges.problem: Users often land on the site in stressful situations and need quick answers.
challenges.solution: I focused on large buttons, shorter content, and always-visible CTAs.

decisions: Mobile-first as the main design approach
Phone and map as the primary actions
Simple layout built for fast contact

goports.title: Goports
goports.description: A custom WordPress theme designed for clear event presentation, smoother editorial work, and lightweight performance without page builders.
goports.overview: A sports website project focused on strong content structure, filtering, and easier day-to-day content management.
work: Custom WordPress theme development from scratch
highlights: Lighter and more organized front-end
Easier editorial workflow
Faster access to events and content

challenges.problem: The WordPress site had to stay lightweight despite having a larger amount of content.
challenges.solution: I built a custom theme with a minimal plugin setup and an optimized front-end.

decisions: Custom theme instead of a page builder
Minimal plugin usage for better performance
Custom content structure for events and categories

studybuddy.title: StudyBuddy
studybuddy.description: A modern tutor discovery platform that combines a clear interface, light animations, and subtle 3D elements.
studybuddy.overview: An educational project focused on friendly UX, a simple tutor selection flow, and a modern visual style.
work: Building a modern and lightweight interface
highlights: Smooth interface despite using 3D elements
Clear user flow from selection to contact
Modern and approachable platform feel

challenges.problem: 3D elements could reduce performance on weaker devices.
challenges.solution: I optimized the models, limited the animation scope, and used conditional loading.

decisions: 3D used only where it improves the first impression
Next.js for speed and better performance
Modern UI without overloading the experience with effects

photographer.title: Photographer Portfolio
photographer.description: A photographer portfolio designed so that all attention stays on the images, while the interface supports their presentation instead of competing with them.
photographer.overview: A portfolio project focused on visual storytelling, gallery aesthetics, and smooth browsing across devices.
highlights: Stronger focus on the photography itself
Comfortable gallery browsing on mobile
More premium personal brand perception

challenges.problem: Large images could slow down the site.
challenges.solution: I used image size optimization, compression, and controlled image loading.

decisions: Minimal interface that does not distract from the photography
Calm color palette that supports the portfolio
Priority on visual experience and smooth browsing

luxenails.title: LUXENAILS
luxenails.description: A colorful and feminine nail salon website designed to present the offer clearly, build trust, and encourage contact.
luxenails.overview: A beauty website project focused on consistent branding, simple service presentation, and a friendly brand experience.
work: Interface design aligned with the brand style
highlights: Friendly offer presentation for new clients
Consistent and attractive online branding
Lightweight website supporting inquiries and bookings

challenges.problem: The colorful visual style had to remain clear and well organized.
challenges.solution: I used a balanced palette, strong headings, and a consistent section grid.

decisions: Clear CTAs and an FAQ section
Service cards ready for future expansion
Design based on a light, feminine brand style
